research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Popl is focusing on developing technologies that enhance digital interactions at events. One area of research involves NFC device activation for teams, where an activation computing device captures an image of a visual credential to extract an activation link associated with a profile. Another development is a method and device for sharing social media profiles, utilizing an accessory with an NFC tag that transmits interaction data when attached to an electronic device. These innovations aim to streamline event lead capture and digital business card functionalities.

about_short_description.short_description: Popl is the AI GTM platform for in-person events — the data layer for everything that happens face-to-face.

product.name: Digital Business Cards
product.description: Electronic business cards that store and share contact information instantly via email, text, social media, NFC, or QR codes without requiring an app for recipients.

product.name: Universal Lead Scanner
product.description: A scanning tool using AI-powered OCR to capture and extract contact details from badges, business cards, and QR codes at events, syncing data directly to CRMs.

product.name: AI-Powered Lead Enrichment
product.description: An AI system that enriches captured leads by filling missing contact and company information from over 50 data sources to create complete profiles.

product.name: Event Campaigns Dashboard
product.description: A time-based lead management system that allows setting goals, qualifying leads, auto-tagging, and scheduling follow-up emails for in-person marketing events.

product.name: CRM and Marketing Automation Integrations
product.description: Native integrations with major CRMs and marketing platforms to sync leads and contacts automatically, including features like custom mappings and de-duplication.

product.name: Team Management and Branding
product.description: Tools to manage teams with subteams, department-specific branding, permission controls, and automated user management via HR platform integrations.
